chips.title: Choose the game edition for companion reports
chips.summary: Let quest and character reports select a game edition and refuse a missing match instead of reading another edition.

evidence.message: Repository review found that reports always select the newest snapshot across game editions. The board has no prior steps.
Board and status passed Dias validation. Implementing edition filtering with synthetic multi-edition tests.
Edition filtering and refusal cases are implemented and documented. All 111 tests passed on Windows using synthetic snapshots.
Next session should plan live addon verification with the operator. Game-client behavior remains unverified; the panel and journal are still planned.
Saved and pushed as commit 515c967. Windows and Linux CI passed. The leak check passed; live game verification remains outstanding.
